model.storage_boundary_note: Hydrogen inventory is forced to zero at each UTC day end; storage shifts production only within each daily horizon, not across days.
model.unit_commitment_boundary_note: On/off, starts, and stops are represented; startup costs and minimum up/down times are not modeled.
model.daily_decomposition_condition: At the base ramp limit (equal to full electrolyser capacity), zero startup cost, no minimum up/down time, and zero end-of-day tank inventory, daily MILPs are separable across UTC days; changing these assumptions invalidates this decomposition argument and requires re-deriving the certificate.
model.startup_cost_note: No project-specific startup cost was identified; transitions are represented and counted but not monetised in this pilot.
model.pv_forecast_method: mean historical PVGIS-SARAH3 output at same UTC month-day-hour; only years before dispatch year; Feb-29 fallback uses adjacent dates if absent
model.settlement_evaluation: Observed SMARD day-ahead prices are used only to score ex-post settlement cost; they are never supplied to the dispatch optimizer.
model.objective_scope: Electricity procurement cost only; no electrolyser/PV CAPEX, fixed O&M, land, water, compression, storage capex, imbalance or grid-connection charges.

checkpoint_format: one JSON file per solved site-year, including daily dispatch rows
